title: Record and replay real client traffic
description: Capture sessions of clients Playwright cannot drive and that send their token on media requests (Swiftfin, Streamyfin, Moonfin and Fladder as read from source, D-030; Infuse once a capture shows it does) against a real Jellyfin through a recording proxy, store them sanitized in compat/, and replay them against jellyscale in the integration tier.
acceptanceCriteria: A recording proxy captures a session and strips tokens and personal data

At least one TV client and one iOS client whose captured media requests each carry a token are captured browsing, playing, seeking and stopping; an app whose player sends none (Findroid, and Android TV's direct play, as read from source) is not a target and is not captured (D-026)
Replays run in CI and fail on a response a client would reject (status, missing field, wrong shape)
No titles or paths from a real library in the captures (synthetic fixtures only)
notes: TV and iOS clients are untested today; Quick Connect and OIDC in Identity need their traffic most. Moved up 2026-11-08: Findroid failed on the dogfood twice where jellyfin-web worked (#44, #47); captures of real non-web clients catch what SDK models alone don't (call order, headers, routes). Scheduled after the web-client work (user, 2026-11-08: focus on the web client first, then pivot to other clients). Findroid and Android TV are no longer capture targets: only clients that send their token on media requests are (owner, 2026-11-20, D-026). Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Third-party Jellyfin apps against Jellyfin (rules 3 and 4).
